Acronym of energy recovery system, an electric generation, storage, and propulsion system used in Formula One, which generates electricity by scavenging excess power and energy, stores energy in batteries, and boosts acceleration with electric motors assisting the gasoline engine.
An inauthentic or inadequate substitute or imitation.
d.x: Back then, we could only get ersatz coffee.

d.d: Something made in imitation; an effigy or substitute.
